summary: The monitors on the main deck suddenly jump back to life, causing Trinity to scream. Tank and Morpheus exchange a look, acknowledging the event as a miracle. Trinity then commands Neo, who is implied to be present given the context of the previous scene and her command, to get up.

what_changes.before: In tears, believing Neo is dead (from previous scene context)
what_changes.evidence: Trinity screams as the monitors jump back to life.
Tank and Morpheus look at each other. It is a miracle.

event_hint.one_line: The monitors reactivate and Trinity orders Neo to rise.
